What Pure MDMA Should Be Like
I have recently been able to get hold of some of the purest crystal MDMA I have ever tried. There used to be a local dealer who was also into the substance scene themselves and so they would use proper lab techniques to recrystallise the stuff off non-water solvents etc.
It is not a stimulant. There is no rush. It is just a pure bliss.
. When the trip is more or less over, I can just lie down and doze off and sleep well. Put on some ambient lights and ambient music, and I'll wake up next morning completely refreshed. None of the pressed pills are that good.
